title: Pilotage: an MCP extension for guided program authoring and verified execution
description: Pilotage is an extension profile over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that lets AI agents safely author and execute programs — SQL, automation rules, workflow documents — against any live system. It standardizes a small set of pieces expressed with MCP's own primitives: a manifest, navigable guides (the grammar), a versioned catalog (the live world), a mandatory side-effect-free validate verb returning structured diagnostics plus a pre-run plan with per-step risk, execution traces carrying per-step inputs, outputs and branch decisions, and one standard client loop. Governing rule: standardize the loop, not the language.
